text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the stage moved to the Hanshin 
Racecourse, the day of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) showdown with fierce rival Narita 
Taishin had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From Kyoto to Hanshin. A course change 
forced a complete rework of the "Formula 
for Victory." Yet, there was no trace of 
anxiety on Biwa Hayahide's face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the prestigious Spring Shield, 
Biwa Hayahide's fighting spirit burned 
bright.
